candidates.test_case: Check the switching logic in parking-lamp and DRL modes.
candidates.applies_because: This exemption covers the lamp's rear position function.

candidates.text: In case the lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources of the system shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
candidates.test_case: Switch the function and verify that all interdependent lamps light and extinguish together.
candidates.applies_because: Being part of a 'Y' interdependent lamp system is an open option for the lamp.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be concealable.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the installation for any concealment device covering the lamp.
candidates.applies_because: Concealment is prohibited for all lamps except headlamps and front fog lamps.

candidates.text: The colours of the light emitted by the lamp functions shall be those listed in paragraph 5.15.
candidates.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of each function.
candidates.applies_because: Each lamp function has a prescribed colour.

candidates.text: The light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
candidates.test_case: Measure rear position lamp chromaticity against the red boundaries.
candidates.applies_because: P-01 is a rear position lamp.

candidates.text: The light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
candidates.test_case: Measure stop lamp chromaticity against the red boundaries.
candidates.applies_because: P-02 is a stop lamp.

candidates.text: The light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
candidates.test_case: Measure reversing lamp chromaticity through the clear window against the white boundaries.
candidates.applies_because: P-03 is a reversing lamp.

candidates.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
candidates.test_case: Measure the retro-reflected colour against the red boundaries.
candidates.applies_because: P-05 is a non-triangular rear retro-reflector.

candidates.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component (e.g. tailgate or boot lid), the conditions of paragraphs 5.18, 5.19 and 5.20 shall be fulfilled.
candidates.test_case: Identify any movable mounting and verify paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20.
candidates.applies_because: Mounting part of the rear lamp on a movable component is possible on M1 vehicles.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp or rear retro-reflector is installed on a movable component, it shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Check position, visibility, colour and photometry with the movable component in each fixed position.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains a rear position lamp and a rear retro-reflector that could be on a tailgate.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp function on a movable component is obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D", only one of the lamps needs to meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements at all fixed positions of the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Verify that at least one D lamp complies at all fixed positions of the movable component.
candidates.applies_because: Being part of a 'D' assembly is an open option for the lamp.

candidates.text: In case additional rear position lamps or retro-reflectors are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Open the movable component and check the additional lamps for position, visibility and photometry.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the lamp is mounted on a movable component and supplemented by additional lamps.

candidates.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component, it shall not cause undue discomfort to road users when the movable component is in a position other than the normal position of use.
candidates.test_case: Assess glare and light direction with the movable component open.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the lamp is on a movable component.

candidates.text: In case the lamp is installed on a movable component, the lamp shall always return to the position specified by the manufacturer when the movable component is in the normal position of use.
candidates.test_case: Cycle the movable component repeatedly and measure the lamp position and orientation after each closure.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the lamp is on a movable component.

candidates.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp and rear retro-reflector shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component in any fixed position different from the normal position of use.
candidates.test_case: Measure the hidden fraction of the apparent surface in each fixed position of the movable components.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp includes a rear position lamp and a retro-reflector.

candidates.text: If the 50 per cent hiding limit is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the rear position lamp shall be switched ON when more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface is hidden by the movable component.
candidates.test_case: Open the movable component and verify that compliant additional lamps switch ON.
candidates.applies_because: This is an alternative if the lamp's rear position function can be hidden by a movable component.

candidates.text: Each light-emitting function of the lamp (other than the retro-reflector) shall be operable when installed; a lamp that cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse is deemed not to be present.
candidates.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that each function operates with its wiring and fuse installed.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position, stop and reversing functions must be functional on the vehicle.

candidates.text: A temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp function is allowed, provided that the replacement function is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the failed function and the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
candidates.test_case: Simulate a rear position lamp failure and compare the colour, intensity and position of the substitute function.
candidates.applies_because: This permission applies to the lamp's rear position function.

candidates.text: During a temporary fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard shall indicate the occurrence of the temporary replacement and the need for repair.
candidates.test_case: Simulate the failure and verify that the dashboard tell-tale activates.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if fail-safe replacement of the rear position lamp is implemented.

candidates.text: In case the rear position lamp (category R2) and stop lamp (category S2) have variable luminous intensity control, the intensities of all such combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
candidates.test_case: Measure the intensities of both functions across the variation range and compare their proportional change.
candidates.applies_because: Variable intensity of the stop and rear position lamps is an open option.

candidates.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, the prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of the stop lamp and the rear position lamp shall be maintained over the entire intensity range, including during variation transitions.
candidates.test_case: Record the stop/position intensity ratio continuously during intensity transitions.
candidates.applies_because: Variable intensity is an open option for the stop and rear position lamps.

candidates.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, an increase or decrease of luminous intensity within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulations is allowed only in relation to ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds or contamination of the light-emitting surface.
candidates.test_case: Review the control triggers and measure intensities against the R148 R2/S2 limits.
candidates.applies_because: Variable intensity is an open option for the stop and rear position lamps.

candidates.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, a decrease of luminous intensity within the limits of the pertinent UN Regulations is allowed while the vehicle speed is ≤ 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is ≤ 20 m, and an already activated decrease may remain active while the vehicle speed is ≤ 50 km/h.
candidates.test_case: Drive and following-distance tests verifying the activation and deactivation thresholds of the intensity reduction.
candidates.applies_because: Variable intensity is an open option for the stop and rear position lamps.

candidates.text: In case of variable luminous intensity control, no sharp variation of intensity shall be observed during transition.
candidates.test_case: Record intensity over time during transitions and check for step changes.
candidates.applies_because: Variable intensity is an open option for the stop and rear position lamps.

candidates.text: In case the stop lamp or rear position lamp was type approved with a special power supply, in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, the voltage supplied at its terminals in the vehicle constant-voltage operating condition shall not exceed the voltage specified for that function as approved.
candidates.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage on the vehicle in constant-voltage operation and compare it with the approval voltage.
candidates.applies_because: The stop and rear position lamps are devices 2.5.4 and 2.5.7, unless exempted by 5.27.3.

candidates.text: In all other cases, for a 12 V system the voltage at the terminals of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall not exceed 13.5 V by more than 3 per cent; the means of controlling the maximum voltage may be located within the lamp body.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lamp terminal voltage with the vehicle in constant-voltage operation.
candidates.applies_because: An M1 vehicle typically has a 12 V system supplying these lamp functions.

candidates.text: In all other cases, for a 24 V system the voltage at the terminals of the stop lamp and rear position lamp shall not exceed 28 V by more than 3 per cent.
candidates.test_case: Measure the lamp terminal voltage with the vehicle in constant-voltage operation.
candidates.applies_because: This applies if the vehicle electrical system is 24 V.

candidates.text: The terminal voltage limits of paragraphs 5.27.1 and 5.27.2 do not apply in case the lamp includes an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control as part of the device.
candidates.test_case: Review the lamp design and approval documents for integrated control gear.
candidates.applies_because: An electronic light source control gear integrated on the PCB is an open option.

candidates.text: There shall be no obstacle inside the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of each lamp function observed from infinity, except obstacles already present when the lamp was type approved.
candidates.test_case: Check the geometric visibility angles on the vehicle or in a CAD sight-line study.
candidates.applies_because: The geometric visibility requirements apply to each installed lamp function.

candidates.text: If any part of the apparent surface of the installed lamp is hidden by other parts of the vehicle, the part of the lamp not hidden shall still conform to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
candidates.test_case: Measure photometry of the lamp with the masking vehicle parts in place, or with equivalent screening.
candidates.applies_because: Body parts may partially mask the rear lamp.

candidates.text: In case the lamp is less than 750 mm above the ground (measured from the H plane) and the vertical geometric visibility angle below the horizontal may be reduced to 5°, the photometric field of measurement of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5° below the horizontal.
candidates.test_case: Measure the mounting height and verify photometry down to 5° below horizontal.
candidates.applies_because: This relaxation applies if the rear lamp is mounted low.

candidates.text: In case the lamp is part of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all interdependent lamps are operated together.
candidates.test_case: Verify geometric visibility with all interdependent lamps lit.
candidates.applies_because: Being part of a 'Y' interdependent lamp system is an open option for the lamp.

candidates.text: The LED modules of the lamp need not be replaceable, provided this is stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
candidates.test_case: Check the R148 communication sheet for the non-replaceable LED module statement.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp uses non-replaceable LED modules.

candidates.text: The rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions shall be type approved according to UN R148, and the rear retro-reflector according to UN R150, when installed on the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Verify the approval markings on the lamp and the corresponding approval certificates.
candidates.applies_because: All lamps must carry device approval under their device regulations.

candidates.text: In case the lamp incorporates a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of UN R148.
candidates.test_case: Check that the R148 approval covers the lamp with its logo.
candidates.applies_because: A logo integrated in the lens is an open option.

candidates.text: On M1 vehicles one reversing lamp device is mandatory and a second reversing lamp device is optional.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and count the reversing lamps fitted.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp contains the reversing lamp for an M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
candidates.test_case: Check the R148 (or R23) approval mark and certificate of the reversing lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The integrated reversing lamp function must carry a valid device approval.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
candidates.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp apparent surface height above ground on the vehicle in the prescribed load condition.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's mounting position on the M1 vehicle sets the reversing lamp height.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp shall be installed at the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the installation position on the vehicle.
candidates.applies_because: The rear combination lamp carries the reversing lamp at the vehicle rear.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp installed at the rear shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle α of 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
candidates.test_case: Verify on the vehicle or by CAD that the reversing lamp apparent surface is visible over 15° up and 5° down.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's apparent surface and mounting must provide this field of visibility.

candidates.text: If only one reversing lamp is fitted, the reversing lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle β of 45° to the right and to the left.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of the apparent surface over 45° left and right by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: An M1 vehicle may carry a single reversing lamp in this lamp.

candidates.text: If two reversing lamps are fitted, each reversing lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle β of 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
candidates.test_case: Verify visibility of each apparent surface over 45° outwards and 30° inwards by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: The M1 vehicle may carry the optional second reversing lamp (left/right pair).

candidates.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
candidates.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp's reference axis must point to the rear when installed.

candidates.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and the propulsion system start/stop device is in a position where operation of the propulsion system is possible.
candidates.test_case: Functional test: engage reverse with propulsion possible and confirm the lamp lights only under these conditions.
candidates.applies_because: The reversing lamp in this product is controlled by the vehicle wiring.

candidates.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the propulsion system cannot operate.
candidates.test_case: Functional test: disengage reverse or switch off propulsion and confirm the lamp is off.
candidates.applies_because: The reversing lamp in this product is controlled by the vehicle wiring.

candidates.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
candidates.test_case: Check R148 requirements and verify the failure tell-tale operates by simulating LED failure.
candidates.applies_because: The LED reversing lamp may be subject to failure-indication requirements of R148.

candidates.text: Stop lamp devices of category S1 or S2 are mandatory on the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of S1/S2 stop lamps.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp provides the S1/S2 stop lamp of the M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: Two S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be fitted, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
candidates.test_case: Check the number of stop lamps and their R148/R7 approval marks.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp function of this lamp (left/right pair) must carry device approval.

candidates.text: For M1 vehicles, the point of the apparent surface of an S1 or S2 stop lamp in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp position in this lamp determines the lateral distance on the M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
candidates.test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp height is set by the lamp's mounting position.

candidates.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the installation position.
candidates.applies_because: The rear combination lamp carries the S1/S2 stop lamp.

candidates.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; for stop lamps mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
candidates.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp apparent surface must be visible in this field when installed.

candidates.text: S1 or S2 stop lamps shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
candidates.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the stop lamp apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp apparent surface must be visible in this field when installed.

candidates.text: The stop lamp shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp reference axis must point rearwards.

candidates.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
candidates.test_case: Apply the service brake and confirm all stop lamps light simultaneously.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp of this lamp is activated by the vehicle braking signal.

candidates.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device which starts and/or stops the propulsion system is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
candidates.test_case: Functional check of stop lamp with propulsion system off (optional behaviour).
candidates.applies_because: This permission applies to the stop lamp function of the product.

candidates.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
candidates.test_case: Simulate LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale if required by R148.
candidates.applies_because: The LED stop lamp may be subject to failure-indication requirements of R148.

candidates.text: Rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are mandatory.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of rear position lamps.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp provides the rear position lamp of the vehicle.

candidates.text: Two rear position lamps shall be fitted, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7 or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
candidates.test_case: Check the number of rear position lamps and their approval marks.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp function (left/right pair) must carry device approval.

candidates.text: The point on the apparent surface of the rear position lamp in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the rear position lamp apparent surface to the vehicle outer edge.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp location in this lamp determines the lateral distance.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp shall be mounted not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm above the ground (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed).
candidates.test_case: Measure the rear position lamp apparent surface height above ground.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp height is set by the lamp's mounting position.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the installation position.
candidates.applies_because: The rear combination lamp carries the rear position lamp.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the inward angle may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
candidates.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp apparent surface must be visible in this field.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 15° above and below the horizontal; where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
candidates.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp apparent surface must be visible in this field.

candidates.text: For M1 vehicles, as an alternative at the manufacturer's discretion and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed, the rear position lamp horizontal geometric visibility may be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, with the inward angle reducible to 20° under the H plane where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
candidates.test_case: If the alternative is used, confirm a rear side-marker lamp is fitted and verify 45°/45° horizontal visibility.
candidates.applies_because: This alternative field is available for the M1 rear position lamp.

candidates.text: In case of the alternative visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2, the rear position lamp shall have a vertical visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, with the downward angle reducible to 5° where the lamp is mounted below 750 mm.
candidates.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the apparent surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: This alternative field is available for the M1 rear position lamp.

candidates.text: In case of the alternative visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2, to be considered visible the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm², excluding the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light.
candidates.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the boundary angles, excluding the retro-reflector area, and confirm ≥ 12.5 cm².
candidates.applies_because: The lamp integrates a retro-reflector next to the rear position lamp apparent surface.

candidates.text: The rear position lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
candidates.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp reference axis must point rearwards.

candidates.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11, so that the front and rear position lamps (and end-outline, side-marker and rear registration plate lamps if fitted) can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
candidates.test_case: Operate the position lamp switch and confirm simultaneous switching of all related lamps.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp of this lamp is wired into the vehicle position lamp circuit.

candidates.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps is mandatory and shall be combined with that of the front position lamps; this does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
candidates.test_case: Switch on position lamps and verify the combined tell-tale lights.
candidates.applies_because: The rear position lamp in this product must be indicated to the driver.

candidates.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamp is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
candidates.test_case: Simulate LED failure and verify the failure tell-tale if required by R148.
candidates.applies_because: The LED rear position lamp may be subject to failure-indication requirements of R148.

candidates.text: Non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are mandatory on motor vehicles.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the vehicle for presence of rear retro-reflectors.
candidates.applies_because: The lamp integrates the rear retro-reflector of the M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: Two rear retro-reflectors shall be fitted, type-approved according to the requirements for Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3 or the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
candidates.test_case: Check the retro-reflector R150 (or R3) Class IA/IB approval mark.
candidates.applies_because: The integrated retro-reflector (Class IA or IB) must carry device approval.

candidates.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Measure the distance from the outer edge of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle outer edge.
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector position in this lamp determines the lateral distance.

candidates.text: As the rear retro-reflector is grouped with rear lamps, it shall be mounted not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground (1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,200 mm).
candidates.test_case: Measure the retro-reflector illuminating surface height above ground.
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector is integrated in the rear combination lamp and thus grouped with rear lamps.

candidates.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be located at the rear of the vehicle.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the installation position.
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector is part of the rear combination lamp.

candidates.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a horizontal geometric visibility angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
candidates.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility of the retro-reflector illuminating surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: The integrated retro-reflector must be visible in this field when installed.

candidates.text: The rear retro-reflector shall have a vertical geometric visibility angle of 10° above and below the horizontal; where it is mounted below 750 mm (measured from the H plane) the downward angle may be reduced to 5°.
candidates.test_case: Verify vertical visibility of the retro-reflector illuminating surface by vehicle measurement or CAD.
candidates.applies_because: The integrated retro-reflector must be visible in this field when installed.

candidates.text: The rear retro-reflector shall be oriented rearwards.
candidates.test_case: Check the reference axis orientation of the installed lamp.
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector reference axis must point rearwards.

candidates.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
candidates.test_case: Inspect the lamp layout for overlapping retro-reflector and lamp surfaces (permitted).
candidates.applies_because: The retro-reflector shares the lamp body with the rear position, stop and reversing lamps.

candidates.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, it shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all stop lamps fitted.
candidates.test_case: Trigger emergency braking above 50 km/h and confirm all stop lamps operate simultaneously.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp of this product may be used for the mandatory emergency stop signal.

candidates.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, all lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
candidates.test_case: Measure the flash frequency and phase of the stop lamps during emergency stop signal operation.
candidates.applies_because: The LED stop lamp must be able to flash at this frequency if used for the emergency stop signal.

candidates.text: In case the emergency stop signal is given by the stop lamps, the emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
candidates.test_case: Operate the emergency stop signal with other lamps on/off and confirm independent operation.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp circuit of this product may carry the emergency stop signal.

candidates.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
candidates.test_case: Vehicle test: verify activation only above 50 km/h with emergency braking logic signal present.
candidates.applies_because: The stop lamp of this product may be activated as the emergency stop signal.

candidates.text: Any vehicle approved pursuant to this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the approved type by meeting the requirements of paragraphs 5 and 6; series-production rear combination lamps (rear position, stop and reversing lamp and rear retro-reflector) shall therefore keep the installation-relevant characteristics of the approved type: position, orientation, geometric visibility, colour and luminous intensity.
candidates.test_case: Take series-production vehicles or lamps and re-check lamp position, orientation, geometric visibility, colour and on-axis intensity per Annex 9 against the type-approval results.
candidates.applies_because: The production rear lamps fitted to M1 vehicles must keep the R48-relevant characteristics of the approved vehicle type throughout series production.

candidates.text: In case the non-textured outer lens is excluded when determining the apparent surface of one function (F2) of the rear combination lamp, and '7b' is taken as the apparent surface according to paragraph 2.10.2, the adjacent function F1 shall not be transparent to F2.
candidates.test_case: Inspect drawings and the sample with F2 lit, and check that no F2 light passes through the F1 area and that the declared apparent surface matches the Annex 3 Part 7 example.
candidates.applies_because: The combination lamp has several functions (rear position, stop, reversing) behind one outer lens with separate compartments, so apparent-surface determination may rely on this arrangement.

candidates.text: The apparent surfaces of the red lamps (rear position lamp, stop lamp) and of the red rear retro-reflector shall not be directly visible to an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
candidates.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, sweep an observer eye position across Zone 1 at 25 m in front of the vehicle and check that no red apparent surface is directly visible.
candidates.applies_because: The rear combination lamp emits red light and must not show red to the front when installed on the M1 vehicle.

candidates.text: For the check of no direct visibility of red light to the front, Zone 1 shall be bounded in height by horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground, and in width by vertical planes forming an angle of 15° outwards to the front from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passing through the foremost point(s) of contact of the vertical planes parallel to the median longitudinal plane that delimit the vehicle's overall width.
candidates.test_case: Build the Zone 1 envelope (1 m to 2.2 m height, 15° outward from the widest front contact points) in CAD and verify by line-of-sight analysis that the red apparent surfaces are hidden by the vehicle body.
candidates.applies_because: This zone defines where the red lamp surfaces of the rear lamp must not be directly visible from the front.

candidates.text: In case of doubt, the requirement of no direct visibility of red light to the front shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamp, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp, taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
candidates.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity emitted toward the front by each red function on a goniophotometer, including vehicle body shielding where applicable, and confirm it is at most 0.25 cd per lamp.
candidates.applies_because: This is a permitted alternative way for the red functions of the rear lamp to show compliance with the forward-visibility limit.

rejected.text: The moulded plastics retro-reflector of Class IA or IB shall withstand being kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, followed by cooling for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C (heat resistance test).
rejected.applies_because: The PMMA moulded prism retro-reflector is a Class IA/IB moulded plastics reflector.
rejected.test_case: Condition the retro-reflector for 48 h at 65 °C ± 2 °C in dry air, then cool for 1 h at 23 °C ± 2 °C, and proceed to the post-test inspection.

rejected.text: After the heat resistance test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device, and in particular of its optical component, shall be visible.
rejected.applies_because: This is the pass criterion of the heat test that binds the Class IA/IB retro-reflector.
rejected.test_case: Visually inspect the conditioned retro-reflector and its prism optics for cracks or appreciable distortion.
